title: Object names from BambuStudio 3MF are not imported (stored in model_settings.config, not Slic3r_PE_model.config)
body:
### Description of the bug

Object names stored in a BambuStudio/OrcaSlicer 3MF are not loaded. Every object
appears in the object list as an unnamed/numbered entry, so on a project with many
similar parts there is no way to tell them apart without measuring each one.

BambuStudio does not write names into the core `3D/3dmodel.model` — objects there
carry only `id` and a UUID:

    <object id="26" p:UUID="00000026-61cb-4c03-9d28-80fed5dfa1dc" type="model">

The names live in BambuStudio's own `Metadata/model_settings.config`:

    <object id="26">
      <metadata key="name" value="SCHUBOX 5X4X12U V2 M3 BOLT.STEP"/>
      <part id="24" subtype="normal_part">
        <metadata key="name" value="SCHUBOX 5X4X12U V2 M3 BOLT_A"/>

The same file also holds per-plate names, e.g. `plater_name = "Base - 12U"`.

PrusaSlicer reads names from `Metadata/Slic3r_PE_model.config`, which BambuStudio
does not write, so the names are silently dropped. The location and meaning of the
key are the same in both files, so a fallback read of `model_settings.config` when
`Slic3r_PE_model.config` is absent would recover them — the same approach used in
2.7.4 for BambuStudio's renamed multimaterial painting attribute (#12502).

### Project file & How to reproduce

1. Download any multi-part BambuStudio project from MakerWorld — I used
   https://makerworld.com/en/models/2468017-schubox-v2-5x4-m3-bolt-mod
   ("Standard Profile [PETG OR PLA]", 11 plates). The file is under a Standard
   Digital File License so I can't attach it here, but any BambuStudio-saved 3MF
   with named objects reproduces it.
2. Open the 3MF in PrusaSlicer.
3. Look at the object list.

Expected: objects named as in BambuStudio (`SCHUBOX 5X4X12U V2 M3 BOLT`, `SCHUBOX
LID 5X4 V2 M3 BOLT REV 01`, etc.).
Actual: unnamed/numbered objects. In this project that means seven visually
identical boxes differing only in height, plus ten shared parts, with no labels.

Saving the project from PrusaSlicer 3.0 then writes `Metadata/PrusaSlicer3_project.json`
with objects that have `id` and `volumes` but no name field, so the information is
lost permanently rather than just unshown.

### Version of PrusaSlicer

3.0.0-alpha11

### Operating system type + version

macOS <!-- version -->

### 3D printer brand / version + firmware version

Original Prusa Core One, firmware 6.8.1

### Zipped project file & How to reproduce

I imported tje first 3mf file from this print https://makerworld.com/en/models/2468017-schubox-v2-5x4-m3-bolt-mod#profileId-2709435 and the labels didn't show up.

### Version of PrusaSlicer

3.0.0-alpha11

### Operating system

Windows, macOS

### Operating system version

26.5.2

### Printer model

Prusa Core One
